title: Flights to Tanzania: Kilimanjaro, Dar es Salaam or Zanzibar
excerpt: Kilimanjaro, Dar es Salaam or Zanzibar? Which international airport is best depends on your plans.
body:
Tanzania has three main international airports.

## Kilimanjaro International Airport (JRO)

Between Moshi and Arusha. The best choice for Kilimanjaro and the northern safari circuit.

## Julius Nyerere International Airport (DAR)

In Dar es Salaam. The best choice for the southern parks and the coast.

## Abeid Amani Karume International Airport (ZNZ)

On Zanzibar. Ideal if you start or end on the beach.

## Open jaw

A common choice: arrive at Kilimanjaro, leave from Zanzibar. That saves a domestic flight back.

## Connections

From Europe, flights usually connect via the Middle East, Istanbul, Addis Ababa, Nairobi or a European hub. Some direct flights operate from Amsterdam to Kilimanjaro. See [flying from the Netherlands and Belgium](/blog/flying-from-the-netherlands/).

## Arusha Airport

A small domestic airport for flights to the parks and Zanzibar.
